		score = 80
		hash1 = "c8e16f71f90bbaaef27ccaabb226b43762ca6f7e34d7d5585ae0eb2d36a4bae5"
		id = "8612bda2-2576-56c0-a4ba-afbef419ab05"

		$s1 = "AddAtomACreatePro" fullword ascii
		$s2 = "shutdow" fullword ascii

}
